about: Line-by-line sort of the two groups data/control.json marks as mixed (other_taxes, fees_fines_other), fiscal 2027 adopted budget. Not used by the page. Checked by scripts/check_audit_trail.py, which requires each group's lines to add to the group total in data/revenue_per_100.json. Narrative and quotes: research/02-who-controls-what.md, section 'Line-by-line control sort'. In quotes, dot leaders are shortened to ' . . . ' and each quote stops at the fiscal 2027 column.

classes.city: rate or amount set by City Hall, the Council or a city board
classes.state: rate set or capped in state law (or follows a state-set rate)
classes.none: no rate: interest, aid, grants, transfers, audit and refund flows, accounting adjustments
classes.intra: intra-city revenue, added and then subtracted; nets to zero
classes.unsorted: gap between the adopted line and the May executive budget's sub-line detail; no adopted sub-line detail is published
